root_cause.summary: AUTH_PASSWORD is set as Docker container env var but NOT in /a0/usr/.env file. create_auth_token() uses os.getenv() to read it, so token is always non-empty at runtime despite settings.json showing empty string.
details: get_settings() line 426 ALWAYS overrides with create_auth_token() result
AUTH_PASSWORD only exists as Docker env var, not in .env file
dotenv.get_dotenv_value() calls os.getenv() — reads env vars, not .env file

auth_components.password: from AUTH_PASSWORD Docker env var (NOT in .env file!)

stderr_check: /proc/1/fd/2 is empty — no A2A errors in stderr
verification: Both path token and Bearer header return HTTP 200 with valid agent card JSON

flywheel.LEARN: Docker env vars can diverge from .env file. Always check both with 'env' command AND cat .env. os.getenv() reads process environment, not .env files.
